claims: The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II Orion spacecraft is scheduled to splash down at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Artemis II crew will complete a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission marks the first human return from the Moon since 1972.
